knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guideline advises against dry brushing, so the plan's method is used instead.
Section 4.2.2 gives at least 30 to 50 cm beyond the visible mould.
A defective machine is stopped and removed, not patched or used selectively.

practicalCriteria: For a mock equipment set, the learner checks fit, seals and maintenance and marks any defective item for removal.
In a described scene, the learner identifies two unsuitable methods and states why each is unsuitable.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Dry brushing or a dust-raising method is used on a contaminated surface.
Defective equipment is used on the job.
